Round 1

Setup
▼
Turn Sequence Reference 7 Phases
1. Resource Phase
Each hero adds 1 resource to their pool. Each player draws 1 card from their deck. (Action Window follows).
2. Planning Phase
First player, then each player clockwise, plays Ally and Attachment cards from hand by paying matching resources. (Action Window follows).
3. Quest Phase
3.1 Commit: Exhaust characters to commit willpower.
3.2 Staging: Reveal 1 encounter card per active player.
3.3 Resolution: Compare committed Willpower (✦) against total staging Threat. Excess Willpower places Progress on Active Location or Quest. Deficit increases each player's Threat dial. (Action Windows throughout).
4. Travel Phase
If there is no active location, the group may travel to 1 location in staging to make it the Active Location, taking its threat out of staging. (Action Window follows).
5. Encounter Phase
5.1 Optional: Each player may engage 1 enemy in staging.
5.2 Checks: Compare each remaining enemy's engagement cost to player threat; enemies engage if threat is equal or higher. (Action Windows throughout).
6. Combat Phase
6.1 Shadow: Deal 1 face-down shadow card to each engaged enemy.
6.2 Enemy Attacks: Declare defender, resolve shadow effect, subtract Defense (🛡) from Attack (⚔) to assign damage. (Undefended damage bypasses Defense and goes directly to a hero).
6.3 Player Attacks: Exhaust ready characters to attack engaged enemies. Attack (⚔) minus enemy Defense (🛡) deals damage. (Action Windows throughout).
7. Refresh Phase
Ready all exhausted cards in play. Increase each player's threat by 1. Pass First Player token clockwise. (Action Window follows).
